section_summary: This section comprises nineteen individual intelligence and personnel characteristic data sheets compiled on flag officers of the Imperial Japanese Navy. Each standardized record details the subject officer's birth date, promotional milestones, service appointments, court ranks, decorations, and intelligence appraisals. High-ranking officers documented in this section include Admiral Osami Nagano, Vice Admiral Chuichi Nagumo, Vice Admiral Naokuni Nomura, and Rear Admiral Teizo Mitsunami.
